items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That was part of the beginnings of Milestone Records that Dick Katz and Orrin Keepnews started

ctx.x: Yeah, and that disturbed Dick Katz and Orrin Keepnews a little bit but they didn’t speak up about it. Because [when] left to our own devices, smoking and playing a duo medium tempo ended up being a ballad, et cetera.
That’s like playing with a click track in a way.
